Appleton Partners Has Decreased Position in Apple Com (AAPL) as Stock Rose; Verizon Communications (VZ) Holder Lincluden Management LTD Lowered Its Holding
June 29, 2018 - By Migdalia James
Appleton Partners Inc decreased its stake in Apple Inc Com (AAPL) by 1.73% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Appleton Partners Inc sold 2,508 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 142,795 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $23.96 million, down from 145,303 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Appleton Partners Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $911.76B market cap company. The stock increased 0.73% or $1.34 during the last trading session, reaching $185.5. About 15.74 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 29, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
